description.narrative: Fourteen NGOs are supported through the Programme Grant II cycle as follows: Concern, Trócaire, Self Help Africa, Christian Aid Ireland, Oxfam Ireland, Sightsavers Ireland, World Vision Ireland, Plan Ireland, ActionAid Ireland, Vita, HelpAge International, Front Line Defenders, GOAL and Children in Crossfire. (GOAL is funded jointly under PG II and Humanitarian budget in a combined pilot Strategic Partnership).

PGII is Ireland’s largest civil society funding mechanism designed to support long-term development programmes implemented by mainly Irish-based CSOs with the aim of impelling positive change for poor and marginalised people in their areas of operation.
